Omar B: Heads up — invoice-preview for tenant 'delta-works' spiked ~38% at 15:47 UTC. Preview shows duplicate token lines; ledger is unchanged.
Priya R: Any deployments or egress changes around that minute?
Omar B: Ops rotated an egress host at 15:45 while autoscaling. Saw a surge in connection churn in edge logs.
LedgerBot: metric: billing.preview_vs_final.delta{tenant=\"delta-works\"} = 38.4
Priya R: Our preview dedupe runs very early using session_fingerprint = hash(client_ip, conn_id, api_key). If client_ip or conn_id changes mid-request we can emit two preview rows. Final ledger dedupe uses req_id later and collapses them.
Omar B: Also noticed many requests with X-Generated-Client header in the logs (proxy injected per-conn id). Example:
```
X-Generated-Client: proxy-conn-9f2
X-Request-Id: -
Authorization: Bearer key_delta
```
ops-bot: event: egress-rotate pool=us-east-1c started_by=ops-team at=2026-03-15T15:45:10Z
Priya R: Short-term: request ops pin that egress pool for 20m and mute preview alerts for the tenant. Less churn -> fewer false previews.
Omar B: Filed INC-5017 and attached sample diffs and logs. Support is already on it.
Support Bot: action: create INC-5017 assigned_to=@Omar B https://redwood.internal/inc/5017
Priya R: Medium-term proposals: (1) change preview dedupe to prefer X-Request-Id when present; (2) fallback to a payload_hash computed from model+first_64_tokens+tenant_id when req_id absent; (3) add `preview_confidence` flag and make preview rows provisional when session_stability low.
Omar B: +1. But payload_hash is CPU-sensitive at P99 QPS. We should compute it only if req_id missing OR generated-client header present.
Priya R: Agreed. Also telemetry: add counters for events where generated-client used and for provisional preview rows emitted. We need to measure blast radius before wide rollout.
LedgerBot: log: preview_rows_provisional{tenant=\"delta-works\"} = 612 over 8m
Omar B: UX change: console should surface a small badge next to invoice preview totals: "Low confidence — edge routing changed recently" with a link to runbook. That will reduce support churn.
Priya R: I'll draft the console blurb: "Preview totals may overcount when edge routing or connection IDs change. See runbook." Keep link short.
Omar B: Deployment plan: implement dedupe-v2 (prefer req_id, then payload_hash), feature-flag it, shadow in prod for 1h, enable for 2% tenants, then ramp. Add alert to mute preview_vs_final for canary tenants.
ops-bot: action: egress pin requested for pool=us-east-1c by @Priya R ETA=7m
Support Bot: note: customer comms queued once INC-5017 triaged.
Priya R: Follow-ups: PR-6210 (dedupe-v2), MET-144 (telemetry counters), DASH-213 (console badge), INC-5017 (investigation/customer outreach).
Omar B: Also add to rollout checklist: "avoid egress host rotations during autoscale spikes". I'll open a tiny RFC.
Priya R: OK. I'll own PR-6210 and schedule a short retro after canary.
Omar B: Thanks — pin in progress, ticket open, shadow plan set. We'll reconvene after 1h of shadow metrics. :hourglass:
